meta.name: geomaster
meta.description: Comprehensive geospatial science skill covering remote sensing, GIS, spatial analysis, machine learning for earth observation, and 30+ scientific domains. Supports satellite imagery processing (Sentinel, Landsat, MODIS, SAR, hyperspectral), vector and raster data operations, spatial statistics, point cloud processing, network analysis, cloud-native workflows (STAC, COG, Planetary Computer), and 8 programming languages (Python, R, Julia, JavaScript, C++, Java, Go, Rust) with 500+ code examples. Use for remote sensing workflows, GIS analysis, spatial ML, Earth observation data processing, terrain analysis, hydrological modeling, marine spatial analysis, atmospheric science, and any geospatial computation task.

copy.tagline: 分析卫星影像与地理空间数据,构建空间机器学习模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常处理卫星影像和地理空间数据,需要多语言示例
copy.tagline_en: Process satellite imagery and geospatial data, and build spatial machine learning models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with remote sensing and GIS data and need code examples in multiple languages

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能处理卫星影像、矢量/栅格地图、点云等地理数据,进行空间分析(如 NDVI、坡度、路网),并提供 Python 等语言的代码示例。
howto.when: 当用户提出遥感影像处理、GIS 分析、地球观测数据计算等地理空间任务时触发。

say.text: 计算这张 Sentinel-2 影像的 NDVI,并给 Python 代码。
say.note: Claude 会调用栅格库生成 NDVI 代码。

say.text: 对这两个 GeoJSON 做空间连接,统计每个区域的均值。
say.note: 会执行空间连接并输出统计结果。

say.text: 用旧金山 OSM 路网找车行最短路径。
say.note: 会获取路网并计算最短路径。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can process geospatial data: satellite imagery, vector/raster maps, point clouds, perform spatial analysis (e.g., NDVI, slope, road networks), and provide code examples in Python and other languages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests geospatial tasks such as remote sensing image processing, GIS analysis, or Earth observation data computation.

say_en.text: Calculate NDVI from this Sentinel-2 image and provide Python code.
say_en.note: Claude will generate NDVI code using raster libraries.

say_en.text: Spatial join these two GeoJSON files and compute per-zone means.
say_en.note: It will perform the join and output stats.

say_en.text: Find the shortest driving route using OSM streets in San Francisco.
say_en.note: It will fetch the network and compute the route.
